per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled all linked database rows to primary article metadata, Table 1, Fig. 4, and source sequence/identity locators. per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows were source-reviewed from Table 1 with paired μg/mL/μM MIC values preserved; Fig. 4 hemolysis text values were retained as toxicity rows. NA cells were not converted into positive activity.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology is bounded to no direct mechanism assay plus method context; magnetic liposome purification and background literature were not over-promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: Local supplementary .bin files are landing/HTML assets with no structured supplementary tables; OA package contains article PDF/NXML and figures. No local supplement changes the activity, database, or mechanism adjudication.

caution_findings.evidence_context: No linked sequence rows are present locally, so database ID-to-peptide identity is assigned by source-located peptide sequences and complete Table 1/Fig. 4 profile matching.
Hemolysis rows are supported by source Fig. 4 and haemolytic-activity text, but database percentage categories are rounded/category representations rather than a source table.
Database rows normalize or correct some organism labels relative to the author table spelling/abbreviation; source table labels are preserved in final activity records.
The local supplementary .bin files are HTML/landing pages and contain no structured supplementary activity, toxicity, sequence, or mechanism tables.
Mechanism output records absence of a direct antimicrobial mechanism assay and avoids reference-literature overclaiming.

summary: Worker-4/worker-6 source re-review resolved the open database/adjudication ticket by row-level database reconciliation, source-reviewed final activity/toxicity correction, and bounded mechanism adjudication; remaining uncertainties are nonblocking cautions.
